messages:
toni: Quick report from onboarding: sample-app CI flakes because SDK/REST disagree on /admin/status and the CLI coerces flags which makes the SDK call fail silently.
marco: details?
toni: REST: GET /admin/status?detail=true -> 200 + JSON with {ready:true}. Node SDK: client.admin.status({detail:'true'}) returns 400 because SDK sends query as string and backend expects boolean.
vishal: our URL serializer is stringifying all params by default. We added that for simplicity but it breaks typed query params.
toni: also the SDK retries POST /jobs/start on 429 and replays the body. The REST guidance is to set Idempotency-Key or not retry. Sample CLI didn't set idempotency-key so CI double-starts jobs when transient 429s happen.
marco: hmm. So two issues: param type coercion in query + retry semantics for mutating endpoints.
cli-bot: Suggestion: add a strict-typing option to the SDK constructor and a CLI linter to prevent stringified booleans/numbers.
vishal: agreed. Action items: (1) patch node SDK serializer to preserve booleans/numbers for query params and add tests, (2) change SDK retry policy: do not auto-retry non-idempotent POSTs unless Idempotency-Key present, (3) update sample-cli to attach idempotency-key by default for POST jobs and add validation that flags are not JSON-stringified.
marco: I'll open PRs for (1) and (2), include e2e that hits a mocked /admin/status. toni, can you add the failing CI log to the issue?
toni: done: added logs + minimal repro snippet. Workaround for teams: call REST directly from CI or pass --raw-params to CLI for now.
ci-bot: Created issue devex/1102 "sdk-serializer-and-retry-idempotency" and attached CI logs. :spiral_notepad:
marco: thanks all :thumbsup:
